{{Quote|She's this fully loaded droid, and what are your programmed skills? Making a cup of ti'il tea?|Stuart Zissu to C-3PO|<ref name="swsa">''[[Star Wars Science Adventures: Emergency in Escape Pod Four]]''</ref>}}
'''Ti'il tea''' was a type of [[Tea/Legends|tea]]. The young [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Stuart Zissu]] once defied the [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] by saying he was outdated and just good enough to make a cup of ti'il tea. When the offended [[Droid/Legends|droid]] replied that he could speak six million [[Language/Legends|languages]], Zissu feigned to be impressed at the idea that he could make tea in that many languages.<ref name="swsa" />
